question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn.*` as a deprecated compatibility alias for shipped third-party channel plugins compiled before the inbound rename?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow, but plugin SDK compatibility is a maintainer-owned contract decision because it preserves a legacy runtime API name after docs and tests had declared it removed.

options.title: Accept alias after conflict refresh
options.body: Land the object-identical `turn` alias with tests and docs, and keep `channel.inbound.*` as the canonical path for new plugin code.

options.title: Reject core compatibility
options.body: Close this PR and require affected plugin authors to republish against `channel.inbound.*`, accepting that older installed plugins can keep failing until upgraded.

options.title: Accept with explicit deprecation window
options.body: Land the alias but require a documented removal/version policy so the compatibility surface is not permanent by accident.

recommendation.title: Accept alias after conflict refresh
recommendation.body: Land the object-identical `turn` alias with tests and docs, and keep `channel.inbound.*` as the canonical path for new plugin code.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant compatibility decision follows the commit that removed this alias and the PluginRuntime API boundary it changed.
